title: Acme Platform · week of 26 October
_guide: Placeholder week. Keep the structure (opening → one metric → before/after → big feature → quick list → close), replace every line with what is live in production, and keep the `slot` notes until the piece is done. Every line that states a fact lists its claims; evidence/claims.json backs each claim. Narration is impersonal: no team names, no second person. Sentences stay complete: never cut one to fit a duration. Any language works; the voice provider decides the accent.

lines.text: [confident] These are the improvements that reached Acme Platform this week.
lines.slot: Opening: one impersonal sentence that frames the window. Plays over the logo.

lines.text: Weekly active workspaces reached *one thousand two hundred thirty-four*, twelve percent more than the week before.
lines.slot: ONE headline metric from production, written in words so captions match the voice, with its comparison.

lines.text: The reports screen was rebuilt, and here it is with the same data, before and *now*.
lines.slot: Before/after: name the screen and say it is the same data. The divider sweeps on the anchor word set in film.mjs.

lines.text: Totals now sit on top, and the whole table *exports* in one step.
lines.slot: What changed on that screen, one change per clause: each clause gets a ring on the element it names.

lines.text: The big feature of the week is *scheduled reports*.
lines.slot: Name the big feature of the week.

lines.text: A saved view is chosen, a day and a time are set, and the report arrives by email with the latest data.
lines.slot: How it works in two or three steps, impersonal (passive voice works well). Each step appears on its word.

lines.text: Scheduling is already live for every workspace.
lines.slot: Who has it today. The real screen comes in here.

lines.text: Also live this week: faster exports, search with a keyboard shortcut, and clearer change badges.
lines.slot: The rest of the week, quickly: three to five short items, each live in production.
Brand close: the product name and the cadence. No call to action needed for partners.
